title: Otori Emu — Happy Birthday! 2025〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Neighborhood

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Neighborhood Expedition Team, gather 'round!!!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Yeah!
<Yeah!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You know the drill, recruits! Today's mission is to look for fun! There's always excitement hiding in our very neighborhood☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: With you at the helm, Captain Emu, our success is assured.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah hah!
Leave everything to us!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, don't scare the neighbors shouting like that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. This is so exciting! We get to be members of Emu's expedition team!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I'm so glad that she invited us to her special birthday exploration!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You think we'll find amazing treasures or get to experience hair-raising adventures?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Hehe, that's what I'm hoping for!
We'll be following your lead, Captain Emu!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hmm? Where did the Captain go? Emu?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah! You take your eyes off her for one second...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <The Captain is over there. It seems she's already found something.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Over here, everyone!
I've found our first fun of the day!
se_walk_men_001_1
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She has so much energy...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It seems she's been looking forward to today's expedition very much.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, we certainly mustn't allow ourselves to fall behind!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Well done, Captain!
What have you found for us?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Look! A cicada!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Gah! A bug?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
AHHH! Stop right there, Emu!
Don't you dare bring that thing any closer!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Don't worry, Tsukasa! These ones sound really cute when they sing☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That does not put me at ease whatsoever!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Listen to me, Emu!
Place that cicada back on the tree, veeery carefully, and don't provoke it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Before I lose my nerve entirely and run away!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You don't have to be that honest about it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A true cry of anguish, indeed...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: To think I would face such tribulations so early in the day...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hehe. Looks like we got our hair-raising adventure already! Or at least, Tsukasa did.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, how wonderful. I would also... Love to... Zzz...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Come on, Luka! It's not much of an expedition if you sleep through it!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Look, everyone! Check this out!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: W-What is it this time?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That cafe over there came out with a new menu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
They have autumn eggplant Bolognese, and mushroom spaghetti!
Ooh, and pumpkin gratin!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Ooh, that sounds so good! I would love to try the gratin!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <They have chestnut cake, too! Those chestnuts on top are so round and cute☆>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Haha. Everything's a new discovery when you're with Emu, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: True. But it can be fun making adventures out of things you normally wouldn't look twice at.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Speaking of, cicadas like the one Emu found earlier are most active around the end of summer, right?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh, right! And all those items on the cafe's special menu are seasonal, too!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Perhaps Emu is feeling the changing of the seasons, in her own way.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: When you put it that way, “neighborhood exploration” is a pretty neat hobby.

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line: Aaah! Everyone! Come over here!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <What is it?!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What have you found this time... Ack?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I beg your pardon?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: O-Otori...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: H-Hello...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Good wonderhoy! What are you three up to?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, um, just doing some errands...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's nice! Did you buy those on your errands too?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Look at all the party hats!
And funny-shaped glasses! And big party poppers, too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, those are...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They're... Right! Props for your shows, yes?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: R-Right! That must be it. Right?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami, Ichika & Kohane
rows.Line: Ah!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: R-Right! We use all sorts of things for our shows!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: T-That's right. And I'm helping them, since they had to buy a lot.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wooow... So, these glasses with the fake moustache are for your show too? That's so fun!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We thought it might help us make our interactions with the audience more fun.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You did say you were looking to work some humor in, right, Hoshino?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: R-Right, now that we are pros and all...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I just remembered! We have another stop to make! So sorry, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! Good luck on your show!
se_run_women_001_1
se_run_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: W-We made it through, somehow...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What an amazing discovery we made!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I wonder what kind of show it's going to be! I'd love to go see it♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehehe☆
Onward to the next discovery!
